hebrewText: מַשָּׂ֤א דְבַר יְהוָה֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חַדְרָ֔ךְ וְ/דַמֶּ֖שֶׂק מְנֻחָת֑/וֹ כִּ֤י לַֽ/יהוָה֙ עֵ֣ין אָדָ֔ם וְ/כֹ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

tokens.bdb: a burden; specifically, tribute, or (abstractly) porterage; figuratively, an utterance, chiefly adoom, especially singing; mental, desire
tokens.kjv: burden, carry away, prophecy, [idiom] they set, song, tribute.

tokens.bdb: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.

tokens.bdb: repose or (adverbially) peacefully; figuratively, consolation (specifically, matrimony); hence (concretely) an abode
tokens.kjv: comfortable, ease, quiet, rest(-ing place), still.

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
